title: Run Clarity cookieless for every visitor (consentV2 denied) instead of a consent banner
body: Decided by the author 2026-10-29 for EU visitors. src/scripts/analytics.ts calls Clarity.consentV2({ ad_Storage: 'denied', analytics_Storage: 'denied' }) right after Clarity.init: per learn.microsoft.com/clarity/consent-mode Clarity then writes no cookies (_clck, _clsk, nor the bing.com ad ones) and still records heatmaps and sessions over /collect. That is why there is no consent banner and no geolocation: do not add one, and do not flip consent to granted, without the author. The footer privacy line (footerPrivacy* in content/schema/messages.ts) says 'sin cookies'; keep it true. Still unverified against production (needs PUBLIC_CLARITY_ID): docs/TODO.md 'After the merge' lists the cookie check.
not_derivable: The code shows the consent call, not that it replaces a banner the author considered and rejected, nor that its behaviour is still unverified live.
